item.summary: The Public Sector Banks (PSBs) continue to grow rapidly with high asset quality, ably supported by reform enabled prudent credit underwriting and effective risk management policies. The systemic reforms instituted in PSBs are showing fruitful results in the form of high quality rapidly paced credit growth across sectors, especially productive credit growth.
